page.content:
Malory's English compilation of the whole Arthurian arc.

How Le Morte Darthur connects

  • Character: Thomas Malory — Malory compiled Le Morte Darthur.
  • Topic: Arthurian legend — Malory's book is the standard English telling of the whole arc.
  • Work: Historia Regum Britanniae — Geoffrey's Latin king stands behind the romance Malory later Englishing.

What is Le Morte Darthur?

Le Morte Darthur (printed 1485) gathers the French vulgate and English tales into the standard English book: sword, Table, Grail, adultery, and Camlann.

Key threads lead to Thomas Malory, Arthurian legend and Historia Regum Britanniae.
